## Day 1 — Scraping & Text Preprocessing

- What is Natural Language Processing (NLP)?
- Working with Wikipedia: pages, categories, revisions
- Web scraping: HTML tables, the Wikipedia API, and R wrappers
  (`WikipediR`, `wikkitidy`)
- Data preparation and cleaning
- Text preprocessing: tokenization, stopwords, stemming
- The document-feature matrix (DFM) and tf-idf weighting

[Slides](slides/day1.qmd) · [Notes](notes/day1.qmd)

## Day 2 — Topic Modeling & Classification

- Unsupervised vs. supervised learning
- Topic modeling with Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA)
- Interpreting topics and topic proportions
- Introduction to supervised learning for text
- Dictionaries and Naive Bayes classification
- Model evaluation

[Slides](slides/day2.qmd) · [Notes](notes/day2.qmd)

## Day 3 — Embeddings & LLMs

- Naive Bayes classification and model evaluation (continued)
- Word embeddings (GloVe) and nearest-neighbor search
- Visualizing embeddings
- Large language models (LLMs) and the transformer architecture
- Running local LLMs with Ollama

[Slides](slides/day3.qmd) · [Notes](notes/day3.qmd)
